visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a white ceramic pot filled with a rich, bubbling soup containing corn on the cob, meat, and various vegetables. Large, colorful text overlays dominate the upper and middle portions of the screen. (2) The scene shifts to a top-down view of a wooden cutting board where a pair of hands is seen expertly slicing fresh ginger into thin, translucent pieces. A metal pitcher is then used to crush garlic cloves. (3) The hands proceed to slice a large ear of yellow corn into smaller chunks, using a knife to notch it and then snapping it by hand. (4) The focus moves to a stainless steel pot where raw chicken pieces and chicken feet are submerged in warm water. As the water boils, the hands use a large spoon to skim off the white foam forming on the surface, eventually lifting the chicken out. (5) In a different stainless steel pan, the hands pour olive oil and sesame oil from bottles. Ginger slices and crushed garlic are added and sautéed until they become golden brown and curled. Raw chicken pieces are added and stirred with a wooden spatula. (6) Rice wine is poured from a green glass bottle into the pan, and the mixture is brought to a vigorous boil. (7) All the ingredients are transferred into the large white ceramic pot. Chicken broth is added, followed by corn, rehydrated bean curd skin, and various mushrooms including shiitake and king oyster. (8) Frozen tofu, bamboo shoots, wood ear mushrooms, and salt are added. A splash of whiskey is poured in, followed by hand-torn cabbage leaves and goji berries. (9) The final segment shows a woman with reddish-pink hair wearing a white t-shirt and a gray apron sitting at a wooden table. She uses chopsticks to pick up ingredients and a large wooden spoon to taste the broth from a small clay pot, showing an expression of great satisfaction. (10) The video ends with a call-to-action text overlay showing her social media handles.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female narration accompanied by a light, upbeat acoustic guitar and piano BGM in a major key. Sounds of bubbling water and simmering liquid are clearly audible in the background. (2) A crisp, percussive sound of a knife hitting a wooden board is heard as the ginger is sliced. This is followed by a dull thud and metallic clink as garlic is crushed. (3) A distinct 'crack' sound occurs as the corn is snapped. (4) The splashing of water and the metallic scrape of a spoon against a pot are heard as the chicken is blanched. (5) A sharp sizzling sound enters the mix as ginger hits hot oil, accompanied by the clatter of a wooden spatula against a metal pan. (6) A glugging sound follows as rice wine is poured from a bottle, succeeded by a swell in the bubbling sound as the mixture boils. (7) Frequent clinking and splashing sounds occur as more vegetables and broth are added to the ceramic pot. (8) The narration becomes more enthusiastic, describing the additions. (9) A series of slurps and chewing sounds are heard at the end as the creator tastes the soup, followed by soft vocal exclamations of pleasure.
